overall_assessment: HVL section extraction is accurate: all seven canonical sections map to the right headings, arbeidskrav land in coursework_requirements (not assessment), and the Hjelpemiddel / 'Meir om hjelpemiddel' cruft is already stripped. Every pre-pass flag (boilerplate, empty, short, leak->teaching_methods) is a false alarm. Only minor cosmetic noise remains.

findings.description: In learning_outcomes the Kunnskap / Ferdigheter / Generell kompetanse sub-headings are dropped in most courses, leaving three anonymous 'Studenten'/'Kandidaten' blocks. In older plans where the sub-heading is run together with the subject line, the sub-heading survives inline ('Dugleikar Kandidaten', 'Generell kompetanse Kandidaten'), and in 2020 plans a lone 'Dugleikar' line remains. All outcomes are kept (nothing truncated), but the knowledge/skills/competence grouping is lost or inconsistently preserved.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The learning-outcomes sub-headings are not mapped to anything and are removed (or kept only when merged into the same text node) by the heading splitter / .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R.
findings.suggested_fix: Either keep Kunnskap/Kunnskapar/Ferdigheiter/Dugleikar/Generell kompetanse as explicit labels on their own line, or strip them uniformly, including the inline forms 'Dugleikar Kandidaten' and 'Generell kompetanse Kandidaten'.

findings.evidence: Tid og stad for eksamen vert annonsert på Studentweb.
findings.description: Assessment occasionally keeps exam logistics sentences (where/when is announced on Studentweb; submission times). The recipe lists exam logistics as noise inside assessment. Impact is small and the surrounding text is correct.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No logistics-line filter in .clean_sections() for HVL; sentences under Vurderingsform are kept verbatim.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), drop sentences matching '(Tid og st(a|e)d|Innleveringstidspunkt).*Studentweb' from assessment.

findings.evidence:
Ingen.
Eit av dei obligatoriske arbeidskrava i utdanninga skal knytast til fagovergripande tema
findings.description: coursework_requirements starts with the placeholder 'Ingen.' followed by a sentence saying that one of the arbeidskrav must be tied to cross-cutting themes, so the text contradicts itself. Prerequisites similarly carry the 'Ingen' line as a prefix before the recommended prerequisite.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Placeholder 'Ingen' lines are not removed when the section also has other text.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections(), strip leading lines that are exactly 'Ingen'/'Ingen.'/'-' when other text follows.
